tests.title: Jog rotation and touch
tests.why: Check jog function on DDJ-1000; avoid assumptions about HID or analog routing.
steps: Consult the exact DDJ-1000 manual for the relevant connectors and operating mode.
Exercise each jog element on the device and observe MIDI, HID/software response or audio measurement as applicable.
Check slow and fast transitions, all channels/sides, and repeats; save raw evidence and mark unobservable functions as not tested.
equipment: Compatible host software or capture interface when required

tests.title: Firmware and application compatibility
tests.why: Prevent mismatched firmware and software versions from being reported as hardware failure.
steps: Read installed firmware and hardware revision.
Compare with the model-specific official compatibility and downloads pages.
Record operating system, application version, firmware and documentation URL.

tests.title: Four-channel external mixer routing
steps: Connect known-good external sources to each of the four mixer input paths.
Route each source independently through cue and master.
Repeat with DJ software disconnected where the manual permits analog standalone mixing.
